authmodulepath.description: Directory path containing the authentication modules (e.g., authmysql.so, authldap.so)

authmodule.description: Ordered list of authentication module names to use (must match module filenames without .so)

minprocs.description: Minimum number of idle authentication daemon processes to maintain

maxdaemons.description: Maximum number of authentication daemon processes to spawn

daemontimeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which idle daemon processes terminate

debug.description: Enable verbose debugging output to syslog

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging (e.g., auth, authpriv, local0–local7)

usepam.description: Enable PAM-based authentication (required for system users)

pam_service.description: Name of the PAM service configuration file (without .conf extension) — usually /etc/pam.d/courier

logfile.description: Absolute path to a dedicated log file (if not using syslog)

module_instances.description: List of per-module instance configurations (used when non-default module options are needed)

comment.description: Human-readable description of this module instance (shown as comment in config)

config.description: Key-value pairs specific to the module (e.g., MySQL connection options)
